name: nifty_ai_annotation_guidelines_rules
description: Machine-readable operational rules for Phase 8 corporate announcement annotation

dividend_exception.condition: Filing is solely a dividend recommendation or announcement without accompanying financial results or figures
dividend_exception.action: Classify strictly as DIVIDEND, not EARNINGS_RESULTS

secondary_events.rule: Capture concurrent material events as secondary labels where schema permits

below_threshold.override_condition: Explicit economically material information indicates otherwise

fundraising_reservation.description: Reserved strictly for material external capital infusions
eligible_types: Preferential Allotment to Promoters / Private Equity

missing_denominator_fallback.rule: Do NOT blindly apply 0.1% threshold when total share capital denominator is absent
missing_denominator_fallback.action: Evaluate textual economic materiality evidence, assign conservative importance (2), flag confidence MEDIUM or LOW

management_change.substantive_event_rule: Director appointment, resignation, cessation, or demise must NOT be classified as EARNINGS_RESULTS merely because of board meeting reference

director_demise_calibration.rationale: Emotional wording does not imply equity financial impairment unless irreplaceable key executive departure

other_category_boundaries.usage_rule: OTHER must be used ONLY when filing cannot logically map to 17 substantive canonical primary-event categories

substance_first_press_releases.rule: Examine actual economic substance of press release before assigning OTHER

other_category_boundaries.procedural_secretarial_only: Only purely procedural secretarial notifications with zero operational substance map to OTHER

bond_final_redemption.rule: Trading suspension on account of final redemption at maturity is planned debt retirement, not adverse event

preference_share_dividends.rule: Evaluate preferred dividends in face-value context; standard contractual yield is non-negative

subsidiary_incorporation.rule: Routine formation of wholly owned subsidiary is standard expansion; cap at importance 3
